traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are satisfied.
- Core Functionality & REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION/REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA: The `require-branch-annotation` rule visits all significant branch node types (if/else, switch, try/catch, for/while/do-while, for-in, for-of). Tests in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts cover both correctly annotated and unannotated branches across all these constructs, and all tests pass. - Alternative Format Support & REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE: getBranchAnnotationInfo in src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts parses `@supports ` from branch comments and treats it as satisfying both story and requirement requirements. This behavior is explicitly validated by passing tests `[REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE] ...` in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts. - Comment Association & Nested Handling (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING): gatherBranchCommentText uses sourceCode comment APIs with special handling for SwitchCase, CatchClause, and else-if constructs to correctly associate inline and preceding comments with their branches. Tests for nested branches and Prettier-style else-if/catch layouts (plus the dedicated helper tests) confirm correct behavior in complex control-flow and formatter scenarios. - Configurability (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES and validateBranchTypes implement and enforce configurable `branchTypes`. Tests show that only listed branch types are enforced, others are ignored, and invalid types trigger configuration errors with helpful messages, matching the story’s configuration section. - Performance (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION): The dedicated performance test on a large, nested-branch fixture passes within a strict time budget, demonstrating efficient processing of files with many branches as required by the story and its Definition of Done. - Quality Standards & Integration: The rule follows ESLint best practices (RuleTester-based tests, clear metadata, flat config integration) and is wired into the plugin’s recommended/strict presets, with integration tests confirming end-to-end behavior. - User Experience & Error Handling: While the exact message strings aren’t reproduced here, the presence of targeted invalid-case tests for each branch type, nested branch, Prettier edge case, and configuration error demonstrates that the rule reports specific, actionable diagnostics when annotations are missing or configurations are invalid. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md exists and, per prior verified content, documents rule usage, examples, and configuration including invalid-config behavior, satisfying the Documentation acceptance criterion.
